description: This PHP class defines an entity 'EmailTemplate' for a Doctrine ORM in a Human Resource Management system. It maps to the 'ohrm_email_template' database table and includes properties such as id, email, locale, performerRole, recipientRole, subject, and body, along with their getter and setter methods.

classes.name: EmailTemplate
classes.description: Entity class representing an email template with properties for id, email, locale, performer role, recipient role, subject, and body, mapped to a database table.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the email template.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the email template.

methods.name: setEmail
methods.description: Associates an Email object with this template.

methods.name: getLocale
methods.description: Returns the locale string or null.

methods.name: setLocale
methods.description: Sets the locale for the email template.

methods.name: getPerformerRole
methods.description: Returns the performer role string or null.

methods.name: getSubject
methods.description: Returns the subject of the email.

methods.name: getBody
methods.description: Returns the body content of the email.
